notes.subject: Kenaanidenw
notes.rationale: כנעני = literally 'Canaanite', by usage 'merchant' (KJV, LXX 'Canaanite'); bracket gives jagokɛlaw 'traders'.

notes.subject: סדין
notes.rationale: Sadin 'linen wrapper/shirt' is rare (only here and Isa 3:23); rendered sadin-dilanw keeping the loan shape.

notes.subject: kɔboliw
notes.rationale: חגור is 'belted thing' — the belted loincloth/sash; Bambara kɔboli 'waist-tie' keeps the bodily picture.

translation: A ye sadin-dilanw dilan ka u nɔ, a ye kɔboliw di Kenaanidenw (jagokɛlaw) ma.
